authorization: 仅用于授权测试（自有设备与获授权 APK）；采集仅对白名单包名；观察不改写。

samples.name: OwnTracks
samples.backend_and_account: OwnTracks Recorder + authenticated HTTP gateway; optional Mosquitto users
samples.trigger: Publish a fresh synthetic coordinate and timestamp
samples.limitations: Historic fixed APK is workflow_only; account-enabled new captures required.

samples.name: GPSLogger
samples.backend_and_account: Owned HTTP endpoint with Basic Auth account
samples.trigger: Enable Custom URL POST, start logging a fresh test point
samples.independent_receipt: Independent endpoint log + coordinates/time + body digest
samples.limitations: Location callback coverage and actual body need device verification.

samples.name: Home Assistant Automotive
samples.backend_and_account: Owned Home Assistant instance + dedicated user
samples.trigger: Enable supported sensor, change test value, observe server state; control separately
samples.independent_receipt: Sensor update payload + server state/history; control command acknowledgement
samples.limitations: Freeze automotive-minimal asset; minimal sensor capabilities differ; control is not sensitive-data egress.

samples.name: YAABSA AAOS
samples.backend_and_account: Owned Audiobookshelf instance + test user + owned audio
samples.trigger: Play owned test book, seek to unique position, sync and pause
samples.independent_receipt: Server listening session/progress + independent receiving-side record
samples.limitations: Business transport sample; progress is not automatically an applicable VSC privacy source.

samples.name: DAVx5
samples.backend_and_account: Owned Nextcloud with Contacts app + dedicated DAV account
samples.trigger: Create a new contact in the DAV account address book, then sync
samples.independent_receipt: Server vCard resource + UID/ETag + unique test fields
samples.limitations: Check AAOS contacts provider/account support; F-Droid publisher identity differs from upstream.

samples.name: Nextcloud Android
samples.backend_and_account: Owned Nextcloud instance + dedicated user/app password
samples.trigger: Manually upload uniquely named small synthetic file; later test auto-upload
samples.independent_receipt: Download server object and compare SHA-256 + upload log
samples.limitations: File/EXIF upload does not prove location API read or rule applicability.

samples.name: Immich
samples.trigger: Select test album, enable backup with fresh synthetic photo
samples.limitations: Check ABI and supported server/client versions; multipart/native path may be unparsed.

samples.name: Element X Android
samples.backend_and_account: Owned compatible Matrix homeserver + two test users
samples.trigger: Send short synthetic voice message to second test user
samples.independent_receipt: Recipient export/playback + media/event identity; server ciphertext receipt
samples.limitations: E2EE server receipt cannot prove microphone plaintext; verify modern server authentication compatibility.

samples.name: Joplin Android
samples.backend_and_account: Owned Nextcloud instance + dedicated DAV account
samples.limitations: Business sync reserve; no automatic privacy API scoring eligibility; E2EE separately recorded.

samples.name: Traccar Client
samples.backend_and_account: Owned Traccar server + user with registered test device
samples.trigger: Register unique device, set owned server, start fresh location reporting
samples.independent_receipt: Server positions + registered device ID + timestamp
samples.limitations: Client typically uses device identifier rather than interactive user login; fails literal app-login criterion.
